order_title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2018
statutory_act: Section 16 of Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
requirement: Compulsory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) license mandatory prior to manufacture, storage, sale, or government procurement.

issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
statutory_act: Section 16 of Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
requirement: Mandatory ISI mark. No non-certified cement may be transported, marketed, or accepted in civil engineering works.

order_title: Electrical Wires and Cable (Quality Control) Order, 2023
issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
statutory_act: Section 16 of Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
requirement: Compulsory ISI certification for all electric cables used in distribution, household, and industrial circuits.

statutory_act: Section 16 of Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
requirement: All domestic and industrial plugs and sockets up to 250V and 16A must have BIS certification and child-resistant shutters.

order_title: Personal Protective Equipment (Protective Helmets) Quality Control Order, 2021
statutory_act: Section 16 of Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016
requirement: Industrial safety helmets must strictly bear the ISI mark; non-certified protective gear cannot be purchased in public tenders.

order_title: Food Safety and Standards / Packaged Drinking Water Compulsory Certification Order
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution / FSSAI
statutory_act: Section 16 of BIS Act, 2016 & FSS Act 2006
requirement: Packaged drinking water and natural mineral water require dual statutory compliance (FSSAI license + BIS ISI Mark).

order_title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
statutory_act: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) under BIS Act, 2016
requirement: Laptops, batteries, smartphones, displays, and servers must hold valid BIS CRS registration numbers.
